title: download_blob doc: empty accept_type URL shape example is incomplete
description: blob.rs download_blob doc comment: 'pass None when no preference is needed — {type} expands to an empty string per RFC 6570 Level-1, so templates that include ?accept={type} produce ?accept= when accept_type is None.' A caller reading this knows the output URL shape but not whether ?accept= is safe for servers (some servers may reject an empty accept param). The comment should add: 'If the server does not tolerate empty query parameters, omit {type} from the template instead.' This is a documentation gap that will cause user confusion.
